response.sql: SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS AvgUnitPrice, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS AvgBytesPerMillisecond FROM Track t INNER JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name;

assumptions.assumption: The database is SQLite, so `1.0 *` forces real division and a zero `Milliseconds` yields NULL, which AVG ignores. In other engines a zero-length track would raise a division error instead.
Grouping by `MediaType.Name` as requested; if two media types shared a name they would merge into one group. The schema does not prevent duplicate names.
